title: Five trends shaping public health
summary_en: From longer lives to eroding institutional trust, powerful forces are converging in ways that demand new approaches to protecting human health.

title: CAPS students help Trailnet create safer streets
summary_en: WashU Continuing & Professional Studies students mapped collision patterns and the city’s busiest corridors — work that supports Trailnet’s mission to make St. Louis streets safer and more accessible for pedestrians, cyclists, transit riders and drivers.
title_cn: CAPS students help Trailnet create safer streets

title: Technique evaluates reliability of imaging measurements used in medical decision-making
summary_en: Advances in medical imaging and artificial intelligence have revolutionized many aspects of medical practice, but it can be hard to know if a given measurement tool works as intended. A technique developed by WashU researchers can be used to assess the reliability of quantitative imaging tools.
title_cn: Technique evaluates reliability of imaging measurements used in medical decision-making

title: Newly found ‘immune organ’ inside skull directs brain defense
summary_en: WashU Medicine researchers discovered immune hubs in the skull bone marrow responsible for mounting a rapid immune response in the brain, which may point to new ways to fight brain cancer and neurodegenerative diseases.
title_cn: Newly found ‘immune organ’ inside skull directs brain defense

title: WashU builds momentum through AI initiative
summary_en: As the fall semester approaches, WashU’s AI initiative is driving academic innovation across schools and disciplines.
title_cn: WashU builds momentum through AI initiative

title: WashU’s mascot finally has a name: Meet Forest
summary_en: After 101 years, the WashU bear now has a name: Forest. The new name comes with a new spirit. “Forest is really curious, really creative, a little silly and a little sly, so watch out,” says Anna Gonzalez, vice chancellor for student success.
title_cn: WashU’s mascot finally has a name: Meet Forest

title: Laser therapy offers weapon against deadly brain tumors
summary_en: The extent of tumor clearance and timing of treatment are important factors that help improve survival, according to a large analysis of patient outcomes by researchers at WashU Medicine.
title_cn: Laser therapy offers weapon against deadly brain tumors

title: Why WashU’s newest students chose St. Louis
summary_en: The 1,945 students in the WashU Class of 2030 moved onto the South 40 last week. The new Bears, arriving from 29 countries and every region in the U.S., are excited to explore St. Louis’ neighborhoods, food and landmarks.
title_cn: Why WashU’s newest students chose St. Louis
